example_summary: Mr. Bhargava, an advocate, received ₹ 5 lacs for a Supreme Court case on the condition of creating a charitable trust, which he did voluntarily after receiving the fee.
source_provision:
### Statutory Summary Matrix: Diversion vs Application of Income

| Doctrine Aspect | Statutory Basis | Legal Principle | Tax Consequence | taxable Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Application of Income** | Section 4 & Section 28(i) | Income received by the assessee and subsequently spent or transferred to a trust. | Voluntary transfer after accrual does not reduce taxable income. | Fully Taxable in the hands of the recipient. |
| **Diversion by Overriding Title** | Section 4 | Obligation attached to the source of income before it reaches the assessee. | Amount is diverted at source; never forms part of total income. | Not taxable as income of the assessee. |


> [!IMPORTANT]
> Core Judicial Benchmark: The true test is whether the obligation is created on the source of the income or on the receipt of the income after it has accrued.


> [!WARNING]
> Professional Income Trap: Voluntary creation of a charitable trust out of professional fees received creates a case of mere application of income, attracting full tax liability under Profits and Gains of Business or Profession.

director.justification: The case requires classifying whether Mr. Bhargava's fee arrangement constitutes a diversion of income by overriding title or a mere application of professional income.
director.visual_metaphor: A river channel where income either flows into the advocate's reservoir before being spent, or is diverted by an external dam wall prior to arrival.

beat_plan.beat_goal: Establish the background of Mr. Bhargava receiving ₹ 5 lacs for appearing in the Supreme Court on condition of creating a charitable trust.
Compare the legal doctrines of Application of Income and Diversion by Overriding Title under Section 4 and Section 28(i).
Evaluate the core judicial test regarding whether the obligation was attached to the source prior to accrual.
Analyze the specific facts where the obligation was self-imposed by Mr. Bhargava rather than the client.
Conclude that the amount is fully assessable in Mr. Bhargava's hands under Profits and Gains of Business or Profession.

beats.voice_sync_text: നമ്മുടെ Mr. Bhargava ഒരു leading advocate ആണ്. അദ്ദേഹം ഒരു Supreme Court കേസ് ഏറ്റെടുത്തു, അതിന് ₹ 5 lacs ആണ് ഫീസ് നിശ്ചയിച്ചത്. പക്ഷേ ഒരു കണ്ടീഷൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു, ഈ തുക ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ഒരു charitable trust ഉണ്ടാക്കണം എന്ന്.

beats.director_goal: Compare the legal doctrines of Application of Income and Diversion by Overriding Title under Section 4 and Section 28(i).
